title: fill_missing_values: fill NaN / null values in a column
description: Fill missing (NaN/null) values in a single column using a chosen strategy. Supported strategies: 'constant' (fill with a fixed value), 'mean' (fill with the column average), 'median' (fill with the column median), 'mode' (fill with the most frequent value), 'ffill' (forward-fill from the previous non-null value), 'bfill' (backward-fill from the next non-null value). Use remove_missing_values when the user wants to drop rows instead of filling them.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Name of the column to fill. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Fill value used only when strategy is 'constant'. Ignored for all other strategies.

rag_note: fill_missing_values operates on one column at a time. Chain multiple steps to fill different columns with different strategies. For numeric columns prefer 'mean' or 'median'; for categorical columns prefer 'mode' or 'constant'. Use remove_missing_values to drop rows instead of filling them.
